Take (TTWO) Shareholder Stephens Investment Management Group Has Decreased Holding by $3.89 Million; Apple (AAPL) Share Value Declined While Tiverton Asset Management Has Boosted Holding
May 27, 2018 - By Ellis Scott
Tiverton Asset Management Llc increased its stake in Apple Inc (AAPL) by 8.35% based on its latest 2017Q4 regulatory filing with the SEC. Tiverton Asset Management Llc bought 31,904 shares as the company’s stock declined 3.81% with the market. The institutional investor held 414,096 shares of the computer manufacturing company at the end of 2017Q4, valued at $70.08M, up from 382,192 at the end of the previous reported quarter. Tiverton Asset Management Llc who had been investing in Apple Inc for a number of months, seems to be bullish on the $926.90B market cap company. The stock increased 0.23% or $0.43 during the last trading session, reaching $188.58. About 15.45 million shares traded. Apple Inc. (NASDAQ:AAPL) has risen 19.49% since May 27, 2017 and is uptrending. It has outperformed by 7.94% the S&P500.
Stephens Investment Management Group Llc decreased its stake in Take (TTWO) by 5.69% based on its latest 2017Q4 regulatory filing with the SEC. Stephens Investment Management Group Llc sold 35,674 shares as the company’s stock declined 10.17% with the market. The institutional investor held 590,994 shares of the technology company at the end of 2017Q4, valued at $64.88M, down from 626,668 at the end of the previous reported quarter. Stephens Investment Management Group Llc who had been investing in Take for a number of months, seems to be less bullish one the $12.81B market cap company. The stock decreased 0.04% or $0.05 during the last trading session, reaching $112.02. About 1.06M shares traded. Take-Two Interactive Software, Inc. (NASDAQ:TTWO) has risen 67.39% since May 27, 2017 and is uptrending. It has outperformed by 55.84% the S&P500.
